name: SF Dragons Soccer Camp
source: https://www.sfdragonssoccercamp.com/ (home, youth-academy-camp, and player-development-academy-camp pages), read 2026-10-07
neighborhood: Beach Chalet Athletic Fields & South Sunset Athletic Fields
description: Youth soccer camp for kindergarten through 8th grade, coached in a Brazilian style that builds technical skill and character. Two programs run side by side each week: a Youth Academy for K-3 players focused on ball mastery, coordination, and small-sided games, and an Advanced Development Academy for competitive players in grades 4-8 with targeted technique work and personalized development plans. Days include skill sessions, possession games and scrimmages, a goalie and finishing clinic, foot tennis, team building or art, and Friday pizza parties with a "Dragons World Cup Day." Led by head coach Willian Lelis, a former Brazilian professional with 20+ years of coaching experience. Weeks are held at Beach Chalet Athletic Fields, except Aug 3-7 at South Sunset Athletic Fields. Scholarships are available through the camp's Thrive Through Play initiative. Cancellations through March 30 get a full refund; after that, a credit toward another camp date.
dropoffPickupInfo: Check-in at 8:45am, camp runs 9:00am - 4:00pm, pick-up at 4:00pm. Extended care / after care: contact the camp at (415) 350-9779 or sfdragonssoccercamp@gmail.com.
packingList: Water bottle, lunch, snacks, and sunscreen. Comfortable athletic clothing. Shoes or cleats (recommended). A light jacket or sweatshirt -- mornings can be cold.
